|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Assassin's Mark''' is a [[spell]] that [[mark]]s a single target with a [[curse]]. [[Hit]]s against the marked target have added [[critical strike]] chance and multiplier. The marked target grants a [[power charge]] and [[life]] and [[mana]] recovery when killed. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Mark''': Only one mark (regardless of source) can be active at all times. Increasing the curse limit will allow you to apply additional [[hex]]es on top of a mark, but will not let you apply additional marks on different targets or apply multiple marks on one target. * The [[life]], [[mana]] and [[power charge]] on kill is awarded to the killer, not the caster of the mark. Using proxies like [[mine]]s or [[trap]]s, which cannot gain these effects, will prevent the player from gaining the life/mana/power charge. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Critical Strike Multiplier | c1_header = Hits against Cursed Enemies have +x% to Critical Strike Multiplier | c1_pattern_extract = Hits against Cursed Enemies have %+(%d+%.*%d*)%% to Critical Strike Multiplier | c1_pattern_value = %s%% | c2_abbr = Life
per Kill | c2_header = Cursed enemies grant x Life when Killed | c2_pattern_extract = Cursed enemies grant (%d+) Life when Killed | c2_pattern_value = %d | c3_abbr = Mana
per Kill | c3_header = Cursed enemies grant x Mana when Killed | c3_pattern_extract = Cursed enemies grant (%d+) Mana when Killed | c3_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Mods== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%assassins_mark%" AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |group =1 |generation_type=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be find in [[legacy item]] in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%assassins_mark%" AND domain = 1 AND generation_type != "10" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |group =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} The newer version of the legacy mod, use {{sl|id=AssassinsMarkTriggered}} (id: AssassinsMarkTriggered). The older version is not tested, but at least the new version can be supported by [[support skill gem|support gem]] when the mod is found on {{il|Unset Ring}}. {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Assassin's Mark}} ==Related Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%assassins_mark%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%mark_skill%" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Monster version== Some monster also curse the enemies with Assassin's Mark: {{#cargo_query: |tables=monsters |fields=CONCAT("[[", _pageName, "|", name, "]]")=Monster names, skill_ids |where=skill_ids HOLDS LIKE "%AssassinsMark%" AND name != "Vagan's Companion" AND metadata_id NOT LIKE "%PerandusGuard%" AND metadata_id NOT LIKE "%StrIntRelic%" AND name != "Shrine Daemon" AND metadata_id NOT LIKE "%Avatar%" |order by=name }} Various ''Daemon'' monsters are untargetable invisible monsters that act as an agent to apply Mark for various monster modifiers, e.g. {{c|mod|[[Modifier:MonsterModApplyRandomMark|Marked]]}} ({{c|normal|"Applies Random Mark"}}). ==Version history== Until version 3.12.0, player can cast the Mark as aura. This interaction was presented in the game until the monster version, from [[Harbinger (Assassin's Mark)]], are removed from the game in version 3.28.0. [[File:Assassin's Mark aura screenshot.png|thumb|Assassin's Mark aura effect.]] {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Assassin's Mark now has a level requirement of 16 at gem level 1 (previously 24). * Assassin's Mark is now offered to the Shadow for completing Intruders in Black, and can be purchased from Yeena by the Duelist, Ranger and Scion. * Assassin's Mark is no longer offered to the Shadow or Ranger for completing Lost in Love, and can no longer be purchased from Clarissa by the Duelist or Scion. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.1| * [[Mark]]s applied to you by a monster are now removed if you move a great distance away from the monster. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Introduced {{il|Mark on Hit Support}} * The Influence modifiers that Trigger a Mark when you Hit a Rare or Unique Enemy have been removed from the modifier pool, so they can no longer be obtained. * There are other changes that applies to all Mark skills.
